name: Gorax Episode 1: The Cliff to Nowhere
summary: You play as Gorax, a mischievous red demon. The game begins with Gorax stranded on a cliff with no way down, and players must solve quirky puzzles, interact with strange objects, and use creative, physics-based solutions to progress. The hand-drawn, cartoonish art style and humorous scenarios make it a unique and playful
